picks.name: Mark Grusane
picks.source_note: New release on L.I.E.S. (also released on Hot Biscuit Recordings).
picks.bio: Chicago DJ and edit specialist. "Angry Birds" (May 1, 2026) is a six-track L.I.E.S. LP that nods to the "Reactor" sound pioneered by DJ Rush -- machine-programmed madness and chaos.
picks.why_listen: An important facet of the Chicago sound that leans harder and stranger than his usual disco-edit work -- good if you want raw, mechanical house rather than polished.

picks.name: Boo Williams
picks.source_note: Same Chicago house scene as Mark Grusane (above); already seeded via Cajual/House of Underground.
picks.bio: Already in your seeds. "The Recovery" (March 13, 2026) is a special return to Rush Hour, a 4-track release -- "The Recovery", "All Bets Off", "All Over", "The Hunt For House" -- drawing on his classic Chicago styles.
picks.why_listen: Timeless, reliable Chicago house from one of the scene's steadiest hands -- a safe, functional pick when you need something that just works.

picks.name: DJ Sneak
picks.source_note: Same Chicago house lineage as Mark Grusane/Boo Williams (above); already seeded via Cajual roster.
picks.bio: Already in your seeds. "Bounce EP" (June 12, 2026) on Refuge Recordings has four tracks -- Bounce, El Bodeguero, Already Started, Moon Child.
picks.why_listen: Groove-first, low-slung Chicago house -- a natural pairing with Boo Williams or Mark Grusane if you want a full Chicago run in a set.
